description: This file declares the interface for the Beep Client Session Object, including functions for creation, initialization, removal, and object enrollment related to the BSP Execution Environment Plane Implementation (BEEP). It mainly contains function prototypes and licensing information.

methods.name: BeepCreateClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new Beep Client Session object with specified context handles.

methods.name: BeepCsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Beep Client Session Object with specified context handles.

methods.name: BeepCsoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Beep Client Session Object.

methods.name: BeepCsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the Beep Client Session Object.

methods.name: BeepCsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Client Session Object.
